endpoints.primary: J_primary (mean waitingTime + departDelay over the N scheduled vehicles of the manifest), per (model, traffic)
endpoints.service: per evaluation: clearance failure; failure with an open service counter at the end; at least one vehicle waiting >= 300 s

statistics.procedure: adaptive_qmix.protocol.statistics.paired_crossed_bootstrap (frozen code, official=False): training seeds 101-110 (models) x 10 traffic seeds; deterministic comparator broadcast per traffic: D_ij = J_learned(i,j) - J_comparator(j)
statistics.primary_family: 5 profiles x 2 methods = 10 comparisons with the primary comparator

equivalence_margin.rule: delta_profile = 0.10 x mean validation J of the selected primary comparator (oft_g5) of that profile, read from its sealed selection record; fixed before any confirmation run

order: SERVICE FAILURE: at least one learned guarantee evaluation of the (profile, method) fails with an open counter wait -> the J comparison is not interpreted as a success; counts and Clopper-Pearson intervals reported

NOT ESTIMABLE: any other learned failure, or a comparator failure on a traffic (J undefined; never imputed); a descriptive sensitivity without the failing model or traffic is reported, never used for the decision
decision_rules.interval: [L, U] = 99.5 % crossed-bootstrap interval of mean D (learned minus comparator; negative = learned better)
claims_allowed: per profile and method only; no pooling across profiles for a decision

service claim per method: 'no indefinite denial of service on these 50 traffics' only if 0 open-wait failures in the 500 guarantee evaluations of that method, with the Clopper-Pearson upper bound stated
secondary comparisons and the none arm are descriptive (95 %), no decision

secondary_analyses: guarantee - none on the same model and traffic (learned comparator, crossed bootstrap, 95 %)
each learned arm versus each secondary comparator (95 %, descriptive)
Clopper-Pearson intervals for every service event
